text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on CBOT soycomplex calls and good Prairie growing weather. November WCE futures crush margin was -0.66 Friday. Liquidation of July futures was expected to continue. Canadian crushers used 60,298 tonnes of seed in the week ended July 2 but the pace which would usually be construed as bullish was shrugged off by the trade Friday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3735 to the U.S. dollar, fell to 81.84 yen and rose to 1.2718 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 down on spill over pressure.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 lower on CBOT corn calls, July liquidation and good growing weather weighing on new crop futures.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on spill over pressure.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
